note: Declared LLM call sites. This project already mirrors calls to LightTrack (src/lib/llm/tracklight.ts) but its LlmCallTrack carries no use-case name, so every event it emits is currently unattributed — this declaration is the set those events should be attributable to.

use_cases.name: Scan calibration and explanation
use_cases.description: Nine deterministic analyzers produce the evidence for a repo scan; the model calibrates the maturity scores against it and explains them, guardbanded to the signals so it never invents a score.

use_cases.name: Athena interactive turn
use_cases.description: Answers one interactive turn of an org's Athena companion chat, running an agentic tool loop against org memory and MCP tools.

use_cases.name: Athena unattended cycle
use_cases.description: Generates Athena's proactive, unattended standing update from the org's rollup and open proposals in a single bounded, tool-free leg, kept separable from her interactive turns for spend attribution.

use_cases.name: Executive briefing narrative
use_cases.description: Writes the single narrative paragraph of an org's executive briefing PDF from the briefing's own printed figures, rejecting the result if it introduces any ungrounded or misattributed number.

use_cases.name: Shared memory write-intelligence judgment
use_cases.description: Judges whether a proposed memory duplicates, refines, contradicts or is unrelated to an existing one, deciding the supersede path before a write commits.

use_cases.name: Shared memory reflection rollup
use_cases.description: Writes a single rollup summary that supersedes a cluster of near-duplicate memories, producing the memory taxonomy's summary kind.

use_cases.name: Remediation lane headline polish
use_cases.description: Optionally rewrites a completed remediation lane's deliverable headlines in place, one-to-one, into house verb-first phrasing without merging, dropping or inventing entries.
